name: Earth
how_to_detect: central nostril flow, square mirror pattern, yellow hue, sweet taste, steady broad breath
activities_best: fixed works, stable construction, wealth and prosperity actions
source_text: Shiva Svarodaya introductory tables and element verses treat earth as auspicious and stable.

name: Water
how_to_detect: lower nostril flow, half-moon mirror pattern, white hue, saline taste, long cool breath
activities_best: fertility, friendship, nourishment, gentle prosperity works
source_text: Shiva Svarodaya treats water as auspicious and supportively fertile.

name: Fire
how_to_detect: upper nostril flow, triangular mirror pattern, red hue, bitter taste, shorter hot breath
activities_best: daring action, cutting through obstacles, forceful ritual or martial work
source_text: Shiva Svarodaya links fire with cruel and dangerous actions.

name: Air
how_to_detect: side or oblique nostril flow, dotted mirror pattern, blue hue, sour taste, mobile mid-length breath
source_text: Shiva Svarodaya gives air both mobile and loss-inducing qualities; recommendations are conservative.

name: Ether
how_to_detect: rotating or diffuse nostril flow, mixed/cloudlike pattern, mixed hue, pungent taste, subtle unstable breath
source_text: Shiva Svarodaya repeatedly states that worldly action is fruitless in ether while yoga is allowed.
